title: WTO | Global trade statistics
content:
The WTO provides authoritative statistics on merchandise trade and commercial services trade compiled from national and international sources and harmonized using
standard classifications. Annual, quarterly and monthly data are made available along with interactive tools, analytical publications and other documentation to
support research and policy making.
Improving User Experience from WTO Statistical Outputs
Economic research and analysis
International trade statistics: 1952 to current day
An annual compilation of trade statistics has been produced by the WTO and its predecessor — the GATT — since 1952.
The following interactive tools are available:
World Trade Statistics – Key insights and trends
The WTO's flagship statistical publication has been transformed into an interactive tool allowing users to visualize annual trade flows for merchandise and services
trade by economy, region, product or services sector. Tables in Excel format are also available for download.
Preliminary data are published annually in April. Revised data are published in July for services and in October for merchandise trade.
Latest trade trends - quarterly factsheets
Handy one-page factsheets provide quarterly data in a visually dynamic format on merchandise trade value and volume and on trade in commercial services.
Statistics on merchandise trade and commercial services trade (annual, quarterly and monthly) can be downloaded from the WTO's online database. Data can be filtered
by economy, product/sector, and time period. Download data as an Excel file or csv file, or create an API account to access the data via API.
The WTO Stats Dashboard is a data visualization tool within the WTO Stats Portal. Data can be visualized via maps or as monthly, quarterly and annual charts.
Merchandise trade: specific tools
Merchandise trade statistics are published in value terms (annual, quarterly and monthly) and in volume terms (annual and quarterly). This includes information on
total exports and imports and, where available, trade by product group and regional breakdowns.
Monthly merchandise trade statistics interactive tool
The new WTO monthly merchandise trade statistics interactive tool provides access to monthly bilateral trade data for 120+ economies and 200+ trading partners across
72 multilateral trade negotiations (MTN) product categories. It can be accessed in the
WTO Tariff and Trade Data platform
Services trade: specific tools
Commercial services data track which services (such as transport, travel, other commercial services, and goods-related services) are traded across economies on an
annual, quarterly and monthly basis. Specialized datasets, such as the Digitally Delivered Services Trade Dataset, the Trade in Services by Mode of Supply (TISMOS)
Dataset and the WTO-OECD Balanced Trade in Services Dataset, offer deeper insights.
Global Services Trade Data Hub
The Global Services Trade Data hub provides access to comprehensive data on services trade, allowing users to explore four distinct services datasets, customize data
selection, and download individual charts and tables.
